name: Shared Canvas
businessHypothesis: Groups may invite others to add to a picture. Repeat contributions and shared-link participation can test whether this becomes a recurring community activity.

name: Debate Stage
description: Discuss a question, reply to arguments and review the evidence.
features: Authors cannot review their own arguments
businessHypothesis: Focused invitations may bring missing perspectives into a discussion. Actual argument quality and repeat participation must be observed before assuming educational or commercial impact.

name: Time Market
description: Offer a skill, agree on an exchange and keep the conversation in one place.
businessHypothesis: A completed exchange may lead to another learning request. Repeat matching and completion can reveal demand for community tools; payments and professional credentials are not managed.

name: Shared Museum
description: Create an exhibition of objects and the stories behind them.
businessHypothesis: A shared collection theme can invite visitors to contribute their own object stories. Curator return use and approved contributions should be measured before assuming growth.

name: Password Team
description: Solve a puzzle together using four different private clue cards.
features: Sequence, two keys and a transformation
businessHypothesis: A player invites three others, and a returning group can switch roles. Role-fill time, incomplete-team abandonment and second-room creation can test the social loop.
